name: Selective Zurich risk and compliance analyst

constraints: Discreet search without public availability signals
context.company_awareness: Has a small employer shortlist and knows sector terminology in German and English.

trigger: A possible office-attendance change prompts a quiet review of alternatives at a few preferred banks and insurers.

searches_run.observation: Returned jobs.ch, Indeed, LinkedIn and reposted vacancies with workload ranges. Direct jobs.ch inspection exposed workload, contract, language and job-alert controls, plus related roles beyond compliance.

searches_run.query: diskret Jobsuche Job Alert Bank Compliance Schweiz
searches_run.observation: Combined retrieval chiefly returned ordinary compliance vacancy pages and job-alert entry points. It did not substantiate confidential-search guarantees or a dedicated privacy-oriented product.

sources.title: Compliance analyst Jobs in Zürich | jobs.ch
sources.supports: Direct inspection shows workload/language/contract filters, alerts and mixed compliance-adjacent titles.

sources.title: Compliance Officer 80–100% Zürich Hybrid | Workpool
sources.supports: Retrieved title combines workload and hybrid criteria; current vacancy not independently verified.

sources.title: Compliance jobs in Zürich | eFinancialCareers
sources.supports: Retrieval advertised job alerts on a sector-specific search page, an alternative to another tool.

best_entry_page.primary_query: Job Alert Compliance Zürich ausgewählte Banken
best_entry_page.promise: Follow covered banks and insurers for new risk and compliance openings, with source requirements for workload and hybrid arrangements.
best_entry_page.cta: Select preferred employers and save a free alert.
proof_needed: Coverage list for target Swiss financial employers
Source examples showing separate workload and hybrid percentage
Verified documentation of account, saved-search and tracker visibility
Explain paid description criteria checks and unknown information

conversion_objections: Does my employer see that I follow competitors?
Will 80% mean workload or remote attendance?
Are compliance officer and analyst both captured without irrelevant IT jobs?
I may not apply for months; a subscription must show sustained value.

avoid_targeting.reason: No absolute anonymity or privacy guarantees have been established.
Professional compliance advice is a different intent from job search.

message_to_founder: Simulation: Ich möchte nur von passenden Stellen bei wenigen Banken und Versicherungen hören. Zeigt mir das Pensum, die genaue Hybrid-Regelung und nachvollziehbar, wer meine gespeicherten Suchen sehen kann; mehr Benachrichtigungen allein helfen mir nicht.

search_journey.fit_reason: Covered roles are searchable; workload and attendance need source checks.

confidence_and_limits: Synthetic simulation, not an interview or an independent respondent. Two queries retrieved on 2026-09-28, with at least one direct page inspection. Queries without observed source IDs are hypotheses. Combined retrieval is not a controlled ranking report. No volume, difficulty or conversion inference. Source claims and role availability can change; product fit uses the supplied repository brief.
